instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: Each player draws 1 card, and neither player takes damage until the end of the opponent's next turn. Each player draws 1 card, and neither player takes damage until the end of the opponent's next turn.

SS non-Tuner Reptile from GY; destroy later. Activate only if all monsters in your Graveyard are Reptile-Type. Select 1 non-Tuner monster in your Graveyard. Special Summon it. Destroy it during the End Phase.

All Warrior-Type monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster you control. All Warrior-Type monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster you control.

If Deck larger: mill until Deck sizes match. If you have more cards in your Deck than your opponent does: Send cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard so you have the same number of cards in the Deck as your opponent.
